def total(count)
  sum = 0
  count.times do |index|
    sum += index
  end
  [1, 2, 3].each { |value| sum += value }
  begin
    sum /= count
  rescue ZeroDivisionError => error
    sum = 0
  end
  sum
end

class Counter
  @@instances = 0

  def initialize
    @@instances += 1
    @value = 0
  end

  def bump(by = 1)
    @value += by
  end
end

$counter = Counter.new
